title: GenerateInpaintParams
description: Params of `generate.inpaint` (specs/09-generation.md §4.3): fill a gap between two parts of the song. The rendered context on each side is a job input asset, `inputs.assets.before` (ending where the gap starts) and `inputs.assets.after` (starting where it ends), each up to 15 s and cut on bar lines. The backend generates `overlapBars + gapBars + overlapBars` so the gate pass can splice inside both overlaps.

gapBars.description: Bars of new audio between the two contexts, not counting the overlaps.

overlapBars.description: Bars of context on each side the model may re-create for the splice searches.

prompt.description: Optional user prompt; artist names are rewritten into descriptors before this point (specs/10-fusion.md §7).

seed.description: Optional base seed that overrides `context.seed` (an HQ re-render sends the accepted candidate's seed).
